title: REQ · Executions persist as atomically written JSON records with safe ids
summary: JSON execution store saves, gets and lists executions under a directory
description: Context: no persistence exists for worker executions. Desired behavior: store.Store saves one <id>.json per Execution via temp file and rename. Expected result: round-trip persistence and rejection of ids like ../x. Why: recovery after restart needs durable state.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Execution, when Save then Get run, then the returned record equals the saved one
Given three saved executions, when List runs, then all three are returned sorted by ID
Given id ../evil, when Save or Get runs, then ErrInvalidID is returned and no file is written outside the dir
Given an unknown id, when Get runs, then ErrNotFound is returned
technical_constraints: JSON files only; ids must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ and not contain ..
